Comment #3 on issue 71 by guoj...@gmail.com: trouble installing stan on mac
with OS 10.5.8 using Xcode 3.1.4
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=71

As mentioned previously, the first step is to get Rcpp working on your Mac
(i.e,. at least pass the hello world example).

A similar issues for Rcpp previously:
https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-sig-mac/2010-July/007574.html

In addition, from this webpage
http://useyourloaf.com/blog/2011/03/21/compiler-options-in-xcode-gcc-or-llvm.html,
it seems that gcc 4.2 and 4.0 are both in Xcode 3.14. So try to make sure
gcc 4.2.1 is used is important.
